{{Top|leg}}
'''Raivors''' were reptiles of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] valued for their hide, which allowed them to blend into their natural environs. They were predators, and came in two subspecies: a sand-colored variety in the desert, and a dark variety in the mountains.
